note: Keys are `<record group>/<accession>`, the accession folded to letters and digits (`71 A 6682` -> `71A6682`). THE RECORD GROUP IS PART OF THE KEY AND MUST BE MATCHED: an accession number is unique only within its group — `68A5612` names 1 series in RG 59 and 18 in RG 84 — so a lookup that ignores it answers a State citation with Foreign Service Post records. Every series NARA records under an accession is stored; state the count rather than choosing, because a key reaches 58 claimants. `prefixInferred` marks the rows where NARA's string carried no prefix and the shard's own group was used.
